public.label: CynolycusBot
public.summary: A research-first market decision system connecting causal data, specialist intelligence, controlled execution, and auditable operations.

local.details: The local view adds runtime ownership, storage, scheduling, recovery, and broker-boundary context without exposing credentials or account state.

public.label: Market + Context Inputs
public.summary: Bars, quotes, options, orders, news, filings, scheduled events, macro context, and stored research artifacts.

local.details: Inputs arrive through provider adapters or immutable local artifacts with event and availability timestamps.

public.label: Feature + Data Fabric
public.summary: Time alignment, universes, completed bars, causal features, caches, readiness, and shared safeguards.

local.details: Off-hours jobs refresh shared bars and matrices while job guards prevent overlap with fragile live windows.

public.label: Context Intelligence
public.summary: News, catalysts, events, guidance, themes, and social attention enrich specialist and meta decisions.

local.details: Context products are stored and joined by availability time; coverage and taxonomy history vary by source.

public.label: Specialist Strategies
public.summary: Intraday, swing, 4-hour ranking, dealer, and deterministic structure modules solve different decision problems.

local.details: Each module retains its own feature, inference, policy, and evidence boundary even when execution services are shared.
local.runtime_owner: Module runners and combined server schedules

public.label: Policy + Execution
public.summary: Strategy gates, sizing, routes, exits, broker reconciliation, persistent ownership, and audit.

local.details: Paper is the default. Live routes are separately gated and broker responses remain authoritative.

public.label: Research + Control
public.summary: Features, labels, training, out-of-fold and frozen evaluation, backtests, dashboards, scheduling, state, and recovery.

local.details: Operational controls expose health and audit state but do not turn research evidence into live authority.

public.label: Market + Broker Data
public.summary: Alpaca bars, quotes, options, and orders plus Schwab option chains.

local.details: Broker credentials and account payloads are outside the atlas.

public.label: Context Sources
public.summary: News, SEC filings, earnings, macro, rates, FINRA, CBOE, profiles, and public datasets.

local.details: Coverage depth and point-in-time availability differ across collectors.

public.label: Stored Artifacts
public.summary: Versioned parquet, CSV, JSON, JSONL, model bundles, policies, audits, and result locks.

local.details: Raw, processed, model-ready, inference, and audit stores remain separated by convention.

public.label: Time + Universe
public.summary: Market calendars, session boundaries, symbol universes, and decision-time alignment.

local.details: Every downstream feature depends on explicit session and availability semantics.

public.label: Bars + Aggregation
public.summary: One shared stream fans completed bars into strategy-specific timeframes and caches.

local.details: The combined server owns the single free-tier stream and bounded fan-out.

public.label: Causal Feature Construction
public.summary: Backward-looking rolling, exponentially weighted, ranked, and lagged context features.

local.details: Scalers, joins, and higher-timeframe mappings are fitted or shifted before validation/test/live application.

public.label: Readiness + Job Guards
public.summary: Freshness stamps, memory thresholds, single-flight protection, and fail-closed entry checks.

local.details: Heavy jobs are blocked during fragile live windows or under insufficient memory.

public.label: News + Catalysts
public.summary: Ingestion, deduplication, embeddings, tone, source quality, buzz, trajectory, and catalyst records.

local.details: Standalone claims remain limited by corpus coverage and historical availability.

public.label: Events + Forward Guidance
public.summary: Scheduled earnings, macro, SEC, and post-earnings guidance context.

local.details: The module is context and research, not an established standalone execution edge.

public.label: Dynamic + Legacy Themes
public.summary: Embedding clusters, LLM-assisted taxonomy, relationships, memberships, and legacy rotation context.

local.details: LLM output names taxonomy metadata; it does not select orders. Legacy maps remain live dependencies.

public.label: Social Attention
public.summary: Reddit/social collection, attention, sentiment, embeddings, and clustering MVP.

local.details: Historical population remains too limited for a defensible standalone edge.

public.label: Meta Context Matrix
public.summary: Combines specialist scores with liquidity, regime, themes, news, macro, Treasury, and guidance context.

local.details: Expanding-window OOF specialist predictions protect the training slice from in-sample score leakage.

public.label: SPY Intraday
public.summary: A 10-minute GA-XGBoost setup model followed by deterministic one-minute confirmation.

local.details: End-to-end live/replay plumbing exists, but recent live directional evidence is weak.

public.label: Multi-Ticker Swing
public.summary: A 30-minute cross-sectional swing classifier with strategy-specific live features and execution.

local.details: Research and live paths share feature logic; option execution remains a material risk boundary.

public.label: Momentum Expansion
public.summary: A 4-hour cross-sectional continuation ranker and selective expansion policy.

local.details: Shared readiness and execution infrastructure support scheduled ranking and managed exits.

public.label: HTF Swing Ranker
public.summary: A 4-hour cross-sectional swing ranker with a validation-selected long-only policy.

local.details: Top-K evidence is stronger than global calibration; artifact freshness remains explicit.

public.label: Meta Ranker
public.summary: Contextual quality and upside rankers combine specialist and contextual evidence.

local.details: Upside ranking is materially stronger than quality ranking; calibration remains imperfect.

public.label: Dealer Positioning
public.summary: The repository's only gamma-exposure computation: walls, magnets, and flip levels, captured nightly and read by the ranker, the entry gate, and the structure engine.

local.details: Short history prevents strong backtest claims; snapshot availability varies by symbol.

public.label: Dealer Ranker
public.summary: Ranks liquid optionable names from dealer structure and can route separately gated option/equity orders.

local.details: Contract liquidity, duplicate ownership, target notional, and live gates are explicit.

public.label: Intraday Structure
public.summary: A deterministic one-minute confirmation engine with persistent setup states, targets, and replay labels.

local.details: There is no broker-order interface. Thresholds remain uncalibrated against broad history.

public.label: Inputs
public.summary: Broad universe 4-hour bars plus lagged daily, weekly, benchmark, earnings, and liquidity context.

local.details: Shared bar caches and universe snapshots feed matrix construction.

public.label: Feature Engineering
public.summary: Causal 4-hour and lagged higher-timeframe feature families for cross-sectional continuation.

local.details: Feature manifests and readiness stamps protect inference parity.

public.label: Cross-Sectional Ranker
public.summary: Tree-based rank/classification models prioritize the strongest expansion candidates.

local.details: Top-K ranking evidence is more defensible than probability calibration.

public.label: Signal Selection
public.summary: Current candidates are ranked, filtered, freshness-checked, and audited before any plan is built.

local.details: Signal decisions record skips and inputs for later review.

public.label: Entry + Exit Policy
public.summary: Selective entry, explicit target notional, stop/target/scale/time policy, and paper-default routing.

local.details: Shared execution receives strategy-specific rankings and routing functions.

public.label: Shared 4H Execution
public.summary: Readiness, duplicate checks, sizing, route selection, exits, reconciliation, and persistent managed state.

local.details: State persists after order actions so sibling modules do not adopt fresh positions.

public.label: Audit + Evidence
public.summary: Walk-forward OOF, frozen policy tests, signal decisions, order intent, broker responses, and managed-state history.

local.details: Backtests and paper/live records remain separate evidence tiers.

public.label: Trend + Momentum
public.summary: Returns, moving-average structure, slopes, ADX, RSI, and MACD context.

local.details: Backward-looking windows only.

public.label: Volatility + ATR
public.summary: ATR, normalized ranges, realized volatility, compression, and expansion.

local.details: Also informs policy risk geometry.

public.label: Volume + Liquidity
public.summary: Volume, dollar liquidity, turnover, spread/tradability context, and cross-sectional ranks.

local.details: Eligibility and ranking remain distinct.

public.label: Relative Strength
public.summary: SPY/QQQ-relative returns and cross-sectional strength ranks.

local.details: Ranks use only the contemporaneously eligible universe.

public.label: Location + Structure
public.summary: Distance from highs, breakout location, drawdown, and persistence context.

local.details: Used to distinguish late chase from durable expansion.

public.label: Regime + Benchmarks
public.summary: Lagged market, volatility, rates, and benchmark context.

local.details: Availability alignment is explicit.

public.label: Daily + Weekly Context
public.summary: Lagged daily and weekly returns, trends, ATR, and survival context.

local.details: Higher-timeframe values are shifted before intraday mapping.

public.label: Inputs
public.summary: Thirty-minute bars, shorter execution context, benchmark bars, universe metadata, and lagged daily context.

local.details: Raw and processed stores remain distinct.

public.label: Feature Engineering
public.summary: Shared offline/live 30-minute trend, momentum, volatility, liquidity, relative-strength, and context features.

local.details: Live inference reuses the offline feature builder.

public.label: Swing Classifier
public.summary: Multiclass swing-zone probabilities and challenger ranking artifacts.

local.details: Frozen classifier and ranker artifacts are evaluated separately.

public.label: Rank + Confirmation
public.summary: Universe scanning, probability/rank filtering, freshness checks, and shorter-timeframe confirmation.

local.details: Entry price intent and broker fill are distinct audit events.

public.label: Swing Order Policy
public.summary: Direction, option/equity route, liquidity/expiry gates, target notional, ATR management, and position limits.

local.details: Sibling-owned positions are vetoed during broker reconciliation.

public.label: Execution + Reconciliation
public.summary: Strategy-specific position management, broker-authoritative state, exits, restore handling, and duplicate protection.

local.details: Ownership boundaries prevent cross-module adoption and flattening.

public.label: Audit + Evidence
public.summary: Frozen classifier/backtest evidence, replay trades, session records, option forensics, and policy experiments.

local.details: Directional signal quality and option execution quality are reported separately.

public.label: Trend + Momentum
public.summary: Returns, moving averages, slopes, oscillators, and continuation/reversal context.

local.details: Feature calculation is shared with live inference.

public.label: Volatility + ATR
public.summary: Range, ATR, volatility, compression, and move-normalization context.

local.details: ATR also anchors policy geometry.

public.label: Liquidity + Tradability
public.summary: Volume, dollar volume, gaps, spreads, and universe eligibility context.

local.details: Underlying and option-contract liquidity are separate gates.

public.label: Relative Strength
public.summary: SPY/QQQ-relative returns, beta context, and cross-sectional ranks.

local.details: Ranks are calculated on the eligible contemporaneous universe.

public.label: Swing Location
public.summary: Pivot zones, distance from highs/lows, breakout context, and recent run-up.

local.details: Labels and live features remain separate responsibilities.

public.label: Regime + Daily Context
public.summary: Lagged market, daily trend/ATR, earnings, sector, and benchmark context.

local.details: Daily context is persisted and refreshed outside the session path.

public.label: Shared 4H Engine
public.summary: Readiness, plan execution, sizing, duplicate checks, exits, persistence, and audit for 4-hour modules.

local.details: Injected ranking and routing keep strategy intelligence separate.
local.runtime_owner: Momentum, HTF, Meta, and selected Dealer paths

public.label: Strategy Gates
public.summary: Freshness, conviction, direction, timing, liquidity, expiry, buying-power, and ownership gates.

local.details: Gate decisions are audited rather than silently dropped.

public.label: Sizing + Exit Policy
public.summary: Target notional, position caps, stop, target, scale-out, trail, and time exits.

local.details: Policies remain module-aware and are not assumed transferable.

public.label: Broker Boundary
public.summary: Separately gated paper/live routes with authoritative order, position, rejection, and fill responses.

local.details: Credentials, account identifiers, and current brokerage state never enter the atlas.

public.label: Audit + Persistent Ownership
public.summary: Signal inputs, order intent, responses, fills, managed state, ledgers, and recovery rationale.

local.details: Module ownership protects shared accounts from cross-strategy adoption.

public.label: Reconciliation Internals
public.summary: Local-only ownership and recovery detail.

local.details: Broker snapshots, module-managed symbols, restored-position rules, and per-order state persistence.

public.label: Feature + Label Research
public.summary: Explicit feature definitions, forward targets, split boundaries, and leakage checks.

local.details: Raw, engineered, label, and model-ready stages stay distinct.

public.label: OOF + Frozen Evaluation
public.summary: Embargoed walk-forward OOF, validation selection, frozen tests, ablations, and results locks.

local.details: Evidence tiers separate robust evaluation from weaker same-split sweeps.

public.label: Dashboards + Operator Views
public.summary: Module dashboards, hub status, live/replay views, alerts, and audit inspection.

local.details: Controls remain separate from this read-only atlas.

public.label: Runtime Operations
public.summary: Local-only view of the runtime harness detailed under Runtime Harness and Management.

local.details: Supervision, watchdogs, readiness schedules, memory guards, persistent state, and recovery ownership.

public.label: Reports + Provenance
public.summary: Capstone evidence, daily live reviews, leakage audits, figures, and durable handoff notes.

local.details: Claims link back to primary artifacts and limitations.

public.label: Governed Decision Path
public.summary: Typed causal states, snapshot assembly, an auditable policy, and the only route by which an approved intent becomes a broker order.

local.details: One module (Meta Ranker) is cut over today; the other strategy modules still execute through the shared 4-hour engine.

public.label: State Producers
public.summary: Module-side adapters that convert module outputs into typed, timestamped state envelopes.

local.details: Market, sector, theme, ticker, portfolio, and readiness producers are wired. The dealer producer is written and tested but has no caller.

public.label: Typed State Contracts
public.summary: Seven state envelopes carrying as-of, available-at, producer version, lineage, and data-quality issues.

local.details: Availability time is separate from event time so a snapshot can never read a state that did not yet exist.

public.label: Snapshot Assembly
public.summary: Selects the freshest admissible state per requirement, and explains in one line why a rejected snapshot failed.

local.details: Requirement results and rejected candidates are rendered by a pure diagnosis helper shared by the live log and the pre-open preflight.

public.label: Policy Engine
public.summary: Hard vetoes then ordered sizing modifiers, each carrying its rule id, input, configured value, and reason code.

local.details: Market, theme, dealer, and data-quality regimes each contribute a multiplier; an unavailable state records a note rather than silently sizing at par.

public.label: Decision Coordinator
public.summary: Turns an approved policy decision into an order request, and accounts for every plan row it refuses.

local.details: A silently dropped row is a position nobody manages, so refusals are recorded rather than skipped.

public.label: Execution Gateway
public.summary: The single broker-facing boundary of the governed path; production-live is refused before a broker client exists.

local.details: Idempotent order and client identifiers, a fill journal, pending-order tracking, and broker reconciliation.

public.label: State + Decision Store
public.summary: Durable states, decisions, orders, and journal entries written through one transactional unit of work.

local.details: A relational store reached over a configured connection; credentials never enter this manifest.

public.label: Preflight + Replay
public.summary: Read-only rehearsal of both decision shapes before the open, plus outcome attribution replayed from stored decisions.

local.details: The preflight exits non-zero when a governed decision would be blocked, so a dead queue is caught before the session rather than after it.

public.label: Market State
public.summary: Index trend, breadth, and volatility regime for the session.

local.details: Published by the market-regime build; a session-lagged market state is bounded by the decision, not by the bar.

public.label: Sector State
public.summary: Per-sector regime and relative strength.

local.details: Published alongside market state.

public.label: Theme State
public.summary: Dynamic theme regime and membership at decision time.

local.details: Carry is bounded so a stale taxonomy cannot be read as current.

public.label: Ticker State
public.summary: Per-name model conviction, liquidity, and alignment fields.

local.details: The dealer-alignment field is declared on the contract but no producer fills it.

public.label: Dealer State
public.summary: Dealer gamma regime and level structure, published with the confidence that earned it.

local.details: A snapshot below the structure floor asserts no regime and resolves to UNKNOWN, which the policy already sizes conservatively; asserting NEUTRAL instead would raise size.

public.label: Portfolio State
public.summary: Equity, buying power, and held positions as the broker reports them.

local.details: Captured read-only at startup and refreshed on schedule.

public.label: Readiness State
public.summary: Whether data freshness authorizes entries at all.

local.details: Fail-closed: an unpublished or stale readiness stamp blocks entries.

public.label: Runtime Harness + Management
public.summary: The supervisor, combined server, schedules, job guards, and recovery machinery that decide when every other component is allowed to run.

local.details: Most live incidents originate here rather than in a model: lock contention, startup ordering, stale caches, and orphaned processes.

public.label: Process Supervisor
public.summary: Starts the stack, and on stop escalates from a signal to a wait to a kill so a wedged server cannot outlive it.

local.details: Escalation was added after a wedged server survived its supervisor and squatted on the ports.

dynamic_dependencies: run_live_server.sh launches combined_server.py as a subprocess

public.label: Combined Server
public.summary: Hosts every module dashboard, owns the module loops, and publishes readiness and portfolio state.

local.details: One process; a module that blocks a request thread degrades every other module hosted beside it.

public.label: Schedules + Startup Catch-up
public.summary: Bar-aligned module loops plus a single sequenced startup catch-up that runs readiness before the nightly collection.

local.details: Catch-ups were independent racing threads until one starved the job that authorizes entries; the nightly job also needs a runway check so it cannot start a multi-hour collection into the open.

public.label: Job Guards + Locks
public.summary: Single-flight heavy-job locking, memory budgets, and blocked-window checks.

local.details: The heavy-job lock is the contended resource behind most catch-up starvation.

public.label: Data + Refresh Jobs
public.summary: Nightly bar and enrichment collection, the data-readiness rebuild, and the weekend full-scope refresh.

local.details: The weekend refresh records per-stage exit codes so a partial Sunday run is visible before Monday.

public.label: Module Dashboards
public.summary: Per-module operator views for rankings, positions, audits, and live scans.

local.details: Dashboard work happens on background threads with cached results; building on the request thread once wedged the whole server.

public.label: Recovery + Reconciliation
public.summary: Restart-time position restore, broker reconciliation, and the operator checklist for a cold start.

local.details: Restored positions can carry synthetic entry prices, which changes what an exit rule believes it is measuring.

public.label: Chain Capture
public.summary: Broker option chains with greeks and open interest for the liquid optionable universe.

local.details: Captured near the close on a liquidity-screened universe across three expiry scopes.

public.label: Gamma Levels
public.summary: The only gamma-exposure computation in the repository: a strike ladder, call and put walls, magnets, and the flip point.

local.details: Exposure per strike is open interest times gamma times contract multiplier times spot, with the put side signed negative; magnets are strikes above a percentile of absolute net exposure.

public.label: Positioning Features
public.summary: Derived structure per symbol and scope: distances, concentration, entropy, densities, vacuum, pinning, and imbalance.

local.details: Computed at capture time and stored with the snapshot, so consumers read features rather than recompute levels.

public.label: Snapshot Store
public.summary: The dated level-summary and strike-ladder history every downstream consumer reads.

local.details: One directory per capture date; an empty file is treated as a capture failure rather than a quiet gap.

public.label: Level Dynamics
public.summary: Snapshot-over-snapshot change and velocity features: wall moves, flip velocity, wall distance in volatility units, and level stability.

local.details: Read by the dealer rankings through a freshness-bounded join; prior snapshots are looked up rather than forward-filled, so gaps stay visible.

public.label: Structural Entry Gate
public.summary: A fail-open, scope-matched veto consulted by other modules just before they commit a contract.

local.details: No model: a hand-written structural veto that recomputes proximity against the live entry price. A missing or stale snapshot allows the trade rather than blocking it.

public.label: Dealer Rankings
public.summary: Ranks the captured universe by dealer structure into the list the Dealer Ranker trades.

local.details: The only path on which gamma structure selects a name rather than merely vetoing one.

public.label: Dealer State Adapter
public.summary: Converts a captured snapshot into the governed path's dealer state, with the confidence that qualifies it.

local.details: Published per row with its own capture time. Maps structure onto volatility regimes only -- never onto a directional acceleration regime.

public.label: Gamma Topology
public.summary: Unsigned structure -- density, concentration, voids, nodes, and term shares -- kept separate from any assumption about who owns the open interest.

local.details: Where gamma sits is close to observable; which side dealers hold is not. Blending them lets a low-confidence inference contaminate a high-confidence measurement.

public.label: Positioning Confidence
public.summary: Structure, sign, and freshness reliability weights attached to every gamma observation.

local.details: Stated priors, not fitted values, and documented as weights rather than probabilities. Sign confidence falls with liquidity because dealer inference does.

public.label: Structural Stability
public.summary: Re-derives every level under shocked volatility surfaces to see which ones survive their own model assumptions.

local.details: Gamma is a model output fed a model input. A level that moves two strikes when IV is nudged was an artifact of the volatility it was handed.

public.label: Intraday Migration
public.summary: Session-scale change features from the one-minute ladder archive: where a wall is going rather than where it is.

local.details: Deltas are backward-looking and are nulled across polling gaps and session boundaries, so an outage cannot look like a violent move.
